quiz.prompt: Wolfram von Eschenbach's Grail epic is…

goodToKnow: Der Gral is the Grail: der Heilige Gral, the legendary vessel sought by knights. In German literature, Wolfram von Eschenbach's Parzival (around 1200) is the great Grail epic, which inspired Wagner's last opera Parsifal (1882); Wagner's Lohengrin is the son of a Grail knight. Figuratively, der heilige Gral is an ultimate goal: der heilige Gral der Physik. It has no plural.
